title: A content worker runs the gate's own changed-paths test selection before it hands back
goal: The worker role file's done bar says a worker of a kb-content-only item runs python3 _tools/tests.py --changed origin/main (the selection the sync gate runs for content: the leak scan among it) before it hands back, so a flagged line fails in the worker and not at the landing's push. Found by the SP-5xnbspyp close: ST-qwrhatjh's worker skipped tests.py as content-only, its done passed, and the landing's sync stopped on test_leaks.py flagging a dashed private key label in the article and _anchors.csv.

run:
import sys
t=open('agents/worker.md',encoding='utf-8').read();i=t.find('3. **Done bar.**');s=t[i:t.find('\n## ',i+3)] if i>=0 else ''
ok='--changed origin/main' in s;print('3. **Done bar.**','names','--changed origin/main',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
